company.name: OneLoyalty
company.shortDescription: OneLoyalty is a shopify-focused loyalty & rewards platform that enables businesses to create referral programs & VIP memberships.
company.description: OneLoyalty is a cloud-based loyalty and customer retention platform built to help eCommerce businesses strengthen customer relationships and drive repeat sales. The platform provides merchants with tools to launch customizable loyalty programs, referral campaigns, VIP tiers, gamification features, and rewards systems across online stores, mobile apps, and Shopify POS channels. It integrates seamlessly with Shopify and various third-party tools, enabling brands to create consistent omnichannel customer experiences. OneLoyalty offers flexible reward options such as discounts, coupons, free shipping, gift cards, and membership perks while also providing analytics and AI-powered insights to optimize customer engagement strategies. The platform is designed to help businesses improve customer lifetime value, boost retention rates, and reduce acquisition costs through data-driven loyalty marketing. With support for integrations, mobile loyalty experiences, and scalable pricing models, OneLoyalty serves growing eCommerce brands looking to build long-term customer loyalty and sustainable growth.
